Query Text: WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (
	SELECT 1
	UNION ALL
	SELECT n + 1 FROM r WHERE n < 100
)
SELECT count(*) FROM r;
Aggregate  (cost=3.65..3.66 rows=1 width=8) (actual time=0.064..0.064 rows=1 loops=1)
  CTE r
    ->  Recursive Union  (cost=0.00..2.95 rows=31 width=4) (actual time=0.001..0.043 rows=100 loops=1)
          ->  Result  (cost=0.00..0.01 rows=1 width=4) (actual time=0.001..0.001 rows=1 loops=1)
          ->  WorkTable Scan on r r_1  (cost=0.00..0.23 rows=3 width=4) (actual time=0.000..0.000 rows=1 loops=100)
                Filter: (n < 100)
                Rows Removed by Filter: 0
  ->  CTE Scan on r  (cost=0.00..0.62 rows=31 width=0) (actual time=0.002..0.058 rows=100 loops=1)
